title: Personal Loans Late Fees: First-Late Share for a Clean Twelve-Month Record
content:
## Rule

A first-late share of a Personal Loans late fee applies, looking at the time fewer than 12 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the late fee's assessment date: no late fee charged on the loan in that time and 12 or more net installment payments in it (payments of type scheduled installment posted, less one for every payment returned whatever it was for) give 0.8; no late fee in that time and fewer than 12 such payments give 0.9; any other loan gives no late-fee share.

The share multiplies the late-fee figure while it is still unrounded, before the late fee is held to no more than the unpaid portion of the installment and rounded to the cent once, at the end.

| Late fee on the loan in that time | Net installment payments in it | Share |
|---|---|---|
| none | 12 or more | 0.8 |
| none | fewer than 12 | 0.9 |
| one or more | any | no share |

## Cases (hypothetical, assessment on 17 May)

- No late fee since 17 May of the year before; 13 scheduled-installment payments and 1 returned payment in that time: 12 net: 0.8.
- A late fee charged 17 May of the year before: 12 whole months back, outside the time: with 11 net payments: 0.9.
- A late fee charged 18 May of the year before: 11 whole months back, inside the time: no share.
